articles.summary: S Indushekhar reportedly killed his wife Sunitha and six of her relatives at their rented house. Following the murders, he and his daughter disposed of the bodies in various locations.

articles.title: ‘Severe’ season: GRAP III in force as air quality plummets; what changes from today
articles.summary: GRAP III was activated in New Delhi as the air quality index continues to deteriorate significantly. The average AQI reached 382 at 4pm on Friday, prompting precautionary measures to be implemented.

Als Nursing Hospital Opens: 14-year ALS drive builds specialised facility; 350,000 donors fund care
articles.summary: In March 2025, the Seungil Hope Nursing Hospital in Yongin welcomed its first ALS patients, marking a 14-year journey led by dedicated advocates Park Seung-il and Sean. This landmark facility, developed with the generosity of over 350,000 donors and government backing, aims to provide advanced care tailored to the unique needs of those with ALS, emphasizing a community's unwavering commitment to enhancing the lives of affected individuals..

articles.summary: French trade unions and student groups are organizing a day of protests against rising living costs. The Yellow Vests movement plans a separate rally in central Paris, despite an official ban on gatherings.

articles.title: He arrived in Israel just two days earlier for a school programme; 17-year-old US student discovers a 3,300-year-old Egyptian amulet from the Bronze Age
articles.summary: A 17-year-old US student, Shiloh Attoun, discovered a 3,300-year-old Egyptian-style scarab amulet during a school excursion to Tel Gezer National Park in Israel. The Late Bronze Age artefact features two cobra motifs representing an ancient Egyptian royal symbol.

articles.title: RBSE Rajasthan Board Exam 2027: Class 10, 12 examinations to begin on February 16
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE) has announced the examination schedule for Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations. Both examinations will begin on February 16, with papers scheduled to start at 10:30 AM.

articles.title: MHT CET Cell approaches police over alleged audio recording promising higher marks; two misleading social media posts removed
articles.summary: The Maharashtra CET Cell has filed a police complaint at Mumbai's Azad Maidan Police Station over an alleged audio recording involving claims of examination centre manipulation and marks enhancement in MHT CET. The recording has been submitted to police for investigation.

articles.title: 55 students from 11 government schools send a 2 kg research payload 35 km above Earth; Coimbatore project takes classroom science into the stratosphere
articles.summary: Fifty-five students from 11 government middle schools in Tamil Nadu's Coimbatore district participated in Project Uyarvu, sending a 2 kg scientific payload to 35 km above Earth using a helium-filled high-altitude balloon. Equipped with atmospheric sensors and a particle trap, the instrument collected environmental data during its nearly three-hour flight.

articles.title: Ranbir starts script for the directorial debut
articles.summary: Ranbir Kapoor says he plans to make his directorial debut within two to three years, calling this his “last decade as an actor.” Already writing a script, he envisions a feel-good family drama. He’ll first complete the sequels to Brahmastra, Animal and Ramayana.

articles.title: 'Mamitha Baiju is always there for me': Anaswara Rajan
articles.summary: Anaswara Rajan highlighted her friendship with Mamitha Baiju during a recent interview. She shared that Mamitha provided support during her health struggles, offering emotional strength.

articles.title: CM Vijay wishes Kamal Haasan, says ‘May you achieve many more milestones'
